use_when: Use it for a password or any secret that should be hidden by default.
Use the hide states for the masked value and the open states when the person chooses to reveal it.
Use Error when the secret fails a rule, and Warning when it is allowed but weak.

dont_use_when.when: Do not put the real password in the placeholder or the helper.
Do not use this field for email, names, or other text that should stay visible.
Do not swap the eye for a decorative icon. It has to mean show or hide.
Do not detach the instance to recolor a status border or status text.
Do not write the label in all caps or end it with punctuation.

variant_intent.State=Default: Default and Hovered — empty. The crossed eye sits at the end of the field.
variant_intent.State=Hovered: Default and Hovered — empty. The crossed eye sits at the end of the field.
variant_intent.State=Typed: Typed hide, Error hide, and Warning hide — the value is masked as ••••••••••. The crossed eye is shown. Typed Open, Error Open, and Warning Open — the value is visible, as in mm245@. The eye is shown.
variant_intent.State=Error: Use Error when the secret fails a rule, and Warning when it is allowed but weak.
variant_intent.State=Warning: Use Error when the secret fails a rule, and Warning when it is allowed but weak.
variant_intent.State=Disabled: Disabled must be disabled in code as well.
variant_intent.revealed=false: Use the hide states for the masked value and the open states when the person chooses to reveal it.
variant_intent.revealed=true: Use the hide states for the masked value and the open states when the person chooses to reveal it.
variant_intent.Show icon: Leave Show icon on, so the person can reveal the value.

placement: After the other fields in a sign-in or sign-up form, before the Primary button: 'Primary Password Input Field' follows 'Email' in the Figma 'Component Appearance' example.

a11y.fact: The label is a real <label> bound to the input with htmlFor and id.
The input type is password while masked and text while revealed.
State=Error sets aria-invalid; Warning is advisory.
The helper is tied to the input with aria-describedby.
The reveal control is a real <button> named Show password or Hide password, with aria-pressed and aria-controls.
State=Disabled disables both the input and the reveal button.
Disabled must be disabled in code as well.
Keyboard focus is not in this set yet. Do not treat hover as a substitute.
